title: Jennifer Lopez Teases ‘Monster-in-Law’ Sequel With Jane Fonda: ‘We’re Talking About Maybe Doing Another One’
content:
ByMya Copeland

Jennifer LopezandJane Fondamight reunite for a “Monster-in-Law” follow-up, the singer and actress teased recently.

In a clip from Lopez’supcoming appearanceon “The Drew Barrymore Show,” she reminisced with the host about past projects, including the 2005 rom-com she starred in with Fonda.

“I love this movie so much,” Barrymore said. “I love Jane. And Michael [Vartan],” Lopez said of her “Monster-in-Law” co-stars.

The rom-com starred Fonda as Viola Fields, a mother-in-law-to-be determined to stop her son (Vartan) from marrying Charlotte “Charlie” Cantilini (Lopez). Monet Mazur, Wanda Sykes, Adam Scott, Annie Parisse and Will Arnett also starred.

Lopez said working with Fonda was “amazing.” “I mean, loved her.” She added, “We’re talking about maybe doing another one.”

Lopez and Fonda have remained close since filming “Monster-in-Law.” In 2013, Fonda spoke at Lopez’s Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony, and the two reunited at a 2025 pre-Oscars party.

Barrymore also showed the audience shots from Lopez’s Fonda-inspired Halloween costume from this year. “The Halloween Barbarella nod was as hot as it gets,” Barrymore said.

“I don’t know what came over me,” Lopez said. “I was like, ‘Maybe I’ll get dressed up,’ and then I thought of Barbarella. It was a little tip to some of the music I’m making.”

Lopez’s appearance is in promotion of her new concert film, “The JLo Show,” created from Lopez’s final performance during her Las Vegas residency. The film premieres Nov. 26 on CBS and will stream on Paramount+. On Friday, the star made headlines for donning a186-carat diamond necklace to the premiere.
title_zh: 珍妮佛·洛佩茲(Jennifer Lopez)暗示與簡·方達(Jane Fonda)合作的《岳母的怪物》(Monster-in-Law)續集：“我們在討論可能再拍一部。”
content_zh:
由Mya Copeland報導

珍妮佛·洛佩茲(Jennifer Lopez)和簡·方達(Jane Fonda)可能會重聚拍攝《岳母的怪物》(Monster-in-Law)的續集，這位歌手和演員最近透露。

在洛佩茲即將出現在《德魯·巴里摩秀》(The Drew Barrymore Show)的一段片段中，她和主持人回憶起過去的作品，包括她與方達共同主演的2005年浪漫喜劇。

“我非常喜愛這部電影，”巴里摩(Drew Barrymore)說。“我喜歡簡。”洛佩茲提到她的《岳母的怪物》搭檔米高·華頓(Michael Vartan)。

這部浪漫喜劇中，方達飾演未來的岳母維奧拉·菲爾茲(Viola Fields)，她決心阻止她的兒子（華頓）與夏洛特·“查理”·坎蒂利尼(Charlotte “Charlie” Cantilini)（洛佩茲飾）結婚。莫內特·馬祖(Monet Mazur)、旺達·賽克斯(Wanda Sykes)、亞當·史考特(Adam Scott)、安妮·帕里斯(Annie Parisse)和威爾·阿奈特(Will Arnett)也參與演出。

洛佩茲表示與方達合作是“驚人的”。“我的意思是，我喜歡她。”她補充道，“我們在談論可能再拍一部。”

自從拍攝《岳母的怪物》以來，洛佩茲和方達一直保持著密切的關係。在2013年，方達在洛佩茲的好萊塢星光大道頒獎儀式上發言，兩人在2025年的奧斯卡前派對上重聚。

巴里摩還向觀眾展示了洛佩茲今年的方達靈感萬聖節服裝的照片。“萬聖節的巴巴瑞拉致敬真是熱辣無比，”巴里摩說。

“我不知道我怎麼了，”洛佩茲說。“我想，‘也許我會打扮一下，’然後我想到了巴巴瑞拉。這是對我正在創作的一些音樂的小致敬。”

洛佩茲的出現是為了宣傳她的新音樂會電影《JLo秀》(The JLo Show)，這部電影是根據洛佩茲在拉斯維加斯駐唱期間的最後一場表演製作的。該片將於11月26日在CBS首播，並在Paramount+上串流播放。上週五，這位明星因在首映式上佩戴一條186克拉的鑽石項鍊而登上頭條。
